description: Factorization of the unconditional bridge 565ccd6c (the ESSENCE_3 to ESSENCE_5 bridge of the essentialist B6 route) into the act-fact link, which both essentialisms accept, and exercise in the nature, which carries the whole dispute with existence-conditional essentialism (controls, law 6, models kantAquinas and conditionalIdentity).
